sample_unit: LLM-generated responses (daily prompts over two months)

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL) of LLM tympanostomy patient education outputs versus sixth-grade threshold
links.effect: All outputs exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading threshold (mean FKGL 9.4 for long-form; 10.6 for layered), with no significant readability differences between prompt strategies.
links.quote: All outputs exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading threshold (mean FKGL, 9.4 for long-form; 10.6 for layered), with no statistically significant readability differences between prompt strategies.

unlisted_practices: Structured/layered prompting to improve LLM patient education accuracy

screen.reason: The study evaluated generative LLMs generating patient education materials and tested whether different prompt design strategies (long-form vs layered structured prompting) improved clinical guideline adherence and readability.
